name: post-hero
description: Blog post header with cover image, breadcrumb, title, author, date, and tags

coverWidth.description: Intrinsic cover width in CSS pixels; omitted when unknown

coverHeight.description: Intrinsic cover height in CSS pixels; omitted when unknown

coverAlt.description: Independent cover description; empty keeps a repeated-title cover decorative

eyebrow.description: Optional line between breadcrumb and title naming what this record belongs to (e.g. "Series · Web as a system capability"); omitted or empty renders nothing

eyebrowHref.description: Optional link target for eyebrow, e.g. the series or collection root; ignored without eyebrow
